title: When AI Agents Should Repair, Replan, or Abandon: A Threshold Theory of Plan Commitment
abstract: arXiv:2611.19663v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents often discover mid-execution that their plan is broken, for example when an action fails or a tool is withdrawn. Deployed systems use conventions such as retry loops or "always replan," and a recent benchmark finds no fixed strategy dominates. This paper derives the optimal policy. In the model, a disruption destroys the causal support of part of a plan; repair is a partial reset that preserves the plan's structure, replanning is a full reset, and changing a plan is costly because others have conditioned on it. The optimal policy is a threshold in effective disruption depth: repair shallow damage, replan after deep damage, and abandon the goal when even a fresh plan is not worth its cost. Depth depends on plan structure. translated_title: AI智能体何时应修复、重规划还是放弃：计划承诺的阈值理论
translated_abstract: AI智能体经常在执行过程中发现自己的计划已经失效，例如某个动作失败或某个工具被撤下。已部署的系统通常采用诸如重试循环或“总是重新规划”之类的惯例，而最近的一项基准测试发现没有任何固定策略占优。本文推导出了最优策略。在该模型中，一次中断破坏了计划某部分的因果支撑；修复是一种保留计划结构的部分重置，重新规划是一种全面重置，而改变计划是有代价的，因为其他主体已经以此计划为前提条件。最优策略是关于有效中断深度的阈值：对浅层损伤进行修复，深层损伤后重新规划，当即使制定全新计划也不值得其代价时放弃目标。中断深度取决于计划的结构。在期望意义上，单个失效动作会迫使 1+R(G)/n 个动作需要重新验证，其中 R(G) 统计通过依赖路径相连的动作对数量；在一阶近似下，完全串行的计划会转为重新规划……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文为AI智能体在执行中遭遇计划中断时的决策建立了最优阈值理论——依据由计划依赖结构决定的有效中断深度，浅层损伤应修复、深层损伤应重新规划、全新计划代价过高时则应放弃目标。
en_tdlr: This paper derives a threshold theory of plan commitment showing that AI agents' optimal response to a broken plan—repair, replan, or abandon—depends on effective disruption depth, which is itself determined by the plan's dependency structure.
